text: おれを　おこらせた　おまえは　ロケットだんの　ブラック　リストに　のるぜ

structure.jp: おれを　おこらせた　おまえは
ロケットだんの　ブラック　リストに

structure.en: will be put, I tell you

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: おれを　おこらせた　おまえ
patterns.explanation: A phrase ending in a verb placed right before a noun describes that noun. おれを　おこらせた　おまえ = 'you who made me mad'.

patterns.name: 〜させる
patterns.explanation: This verb shape means 'make someone do it'. おこる is 'get mad', so おこらせた = 'made (me) mad'.

patterns.name: 〜ぜ
patterns.explanation: ぜ at the end is rough, tough-guy speech that adds 'I tell you'. のるぜ = 'you're going on it, you hear'.
